symbol.title: c_tap
TAP · staffing × training
symbol.desc: Two warm lenses—cobalt staffing and amber training—intersect in a sunflower-lit crucible whose outer resonance arc crests above the frame. Embodies Glaser's 11-Wow and 12-Ambiguity: one shared form with two readings.

symbol.title: c_client
Intake Ensemble (6–8 people)
symbol.desc: Six solid figures lean inward in conversation while two dashed silhouettes hold warm sunflower sparks at their hearts. Embodies Glaser's 04-Greatness and 05-Just-Enough: holding room open for the 7th and 8th person.

Intake Ensemble (6–8 people)
symbol.desc: Six solid figures lean inward in conversation while two dashed silhouettes hold warm sunflower sparks at their hearts. Embodies Glaser's 04-Greatness and 05-Just-Enough: holding room open for the 7th and 8th person.

symbol.title: c_prereq
Shared Prerequisite Bar · same prerequisites
symbol.desc: Two streams converge through a calibration lock while a vermilion arrow passes cleanly through the centre bullseye into a sunflower spark. Embodies Glaser's 10-Truth: a shared bar is not a wall that stops you, but a threshold both sides pass through.

symbol.title: c_cohort
Unified 16-Engineer Crucible Cohort
symbol.desc: Sixteen interleaved client and Pursuit engineers lean toward their partners inside a warm double-walled studio vessel, kindling eight sunflower sparks along the shared workbench. Embodies Glaser's 01-Affection: craft grows between people.

symbol.title: c_contract
8 Billable Charter · 12-Month Commitment
symbol.desc: A folded charter sealed with a forest-green signet holds eight billable seats alongside a 12-month studio calendar whose 13th slot opens into a sunflower horizon. Embodies Glaser's 05-Just-Enough: clear terms without hidden traps.

symbol.title: c_coach
Coaching Taper & Rising Autonomy (5 d/wk → 1 h/day)
symbol.desc: As the plum-podium coach's 3D cadence columns step down, a dashed mountain peak (04-greatness) and forest autonomy curve rise to a sunflower spark. Embodies Glaser's principle that great teaching makes itself unnecessary.

symbol.title: c_contract
Year-End Choice · Hire Direct, Dismiss, or Extend
symbol.desc: From a sunflower-lit junction diamond, three clean tracks lead to forest-green direct hire, clean exit, or extended deployment. Embodies Glaser's 10-Truth: every option at year-end is visible up front.

symbol.title: c_margin
Cohort Unit Economics · $25/h × 40 h/wk × 8 people × 50 wk = $400,000
symbol.desc: Four tactile instrument tiles encode hourly rate, 5-day studio rhythm, 8 paired engineers, and 50 weeks of off-centre tree-ring accumulation (09-aging), compounding into a 3D vermilion & sunflower ingot and 10-cohort stack.

g.text: profit per cohort · could run 10 a year

symbol.title: c_ratio
The Ratio Question · 8 : 8 Parity vs. 8 : 2–4 Catalyst Pod
symbol.desc: Above the tilted 8:8 scale sits Glaser's 08-Doubt question hinge, while on the right a rotated 18° square core (06-style) energizes 8 client engineers with just 2–4 Pursuit catalysts.
